title: REQ · Scene focuses the object matching the store focusedObjectId
summary: BootScene.onStateChange focuses the matching SceneObject using the hover highlight and label path
description: Context: onStateChange only syncs objects. Desired behavior: read focusedObjectId from the game store and call focus() on the SceneObject whose spec.id matches, blurring non-matching focused objects. Expected result: the matching object shows highlight and label. Why: shared focus state must be visible in the scene.
acceptance_criteria: Given focusedObjectId equals an object's spec.id, When onStateChange runs, Then that object's focus() is called once
Given another object is focused and focusedObjectId names a different object, When onStateChange runs, Then the other object's blur() is called
Given focusedObjectId names no scene object, When onStateChange runs, Then no object receives focus() and nothing throws
technical_constraints: Do not call setFocusedObject from the scene to avoid store loops
definition_of_done: Matching object focused on store change
